[ffff64]Flumen Plains[ffffff]
Huh? Isn't there too little water flowing in a\nriver as wide as this?
Yes, this is the river that flows through the\ntown, but it's been slowly losing water for\na while...
It's said that its water source might have started\nto dry up, but what's actually happening has not\nbeen confirmed yet.
I see...Is the source still far from here?
Yes, I heard the water comes from the spring in\nthe valley just beyond the plains...
Usually there's something near the spring that's\nstopping the water from flowing in a case like\nthis. But Coenubias should be afraid of water...
Anyway, we're going to the spring, what about you\nguys? It's gonna be dangerous if there's a dragon\nor Coenubia, so you don't have to come though.
I'll go with you!
W-we're coming too!\nWe've come this far, we can't chicken out now or\nwe'll never become a "Sproutling"!!
OK, fine! But if I or this adventurer tells you to\nretreat, you must listen and go to a safe place.\nGot it?!
Even when we're in the middle of a battle?
Yup! Even when we're in the middle of a battle!!\nThat's because we're borrowing you guys from\nthe leader.
We must return what we borrow, right?\nWe'll be in trouble even when there's only one of\nyou missing, understand?!
U-understood!!
What?
Pelulu, y-you're so cool...
Y-you're so silly!!
A-actually it's your job to tell them that!\nRemember your role, please!!
Alright then, let's go to the spring!\nWe don't know what kind of monsters are waiting\nfor us, so never ever let your guard down!!
